problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate cargo space across 7 distinct shipping routes, each necessitating passage through 7 sequential checkpoint inspections. The revenue generated per ton of cargo on each route is as follows:
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 14.176 per ton
* For Route Beta, revenue is 9.386 per ton
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 6.72 per ton
* For Route Delta, revenue is 15.678 per ton
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 19.686 per ton
* For Route Zeta, revenue is 12.691 per ton
* For Route Eta, revenue is 10.195 per ton

The inspection duration required per ton for each checkpoint is detailed:
* For Route Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.008 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.946 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.157 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.937 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.345 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.963 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.994 (ton-hours)
* For Route Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.513 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.634 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.987 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.458 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.256 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.704 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.349 (ton-hours)
* For Route Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.685 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.768 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.39 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.77 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.186 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.963 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.287 (ton-hours)
* For Route Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.475 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.729 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.446 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.452 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.275 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.615 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.953 (ton-hours)
* For Route Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.248 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.656 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.763 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.655 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.081 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.008 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.421 (ton-hours)
* For Route Zeta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.874 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.137 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.616 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.654 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.891 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.629 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.755 (ton-hours)
* For Route Eta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.684 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.827 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.929 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.227 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.557 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.146 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.424 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 1 must not exceed 119.427 hours
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 2 must not exceed 141.7 hours
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 3 must not exceed 126.488 hours
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 4 must not exceed 83.537 hours
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 5 must not exceed 99.939 hours
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 6 must not exceed 154.225 hours
* The cumulative inspection time at Checkpoint 7 must not exceed 80.519 hours

Given the imperative to ensure that for each checkpoint, the aggregate processing duration does not surpass its allotted availability, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each shipping route to maximize total revenue.
